decisions.reason: Turnaround management software sits at the core of the firm's integrated, data-driven airport operations offer and has its own web page. It likely meets aspirations, and the growing, investing firm has ample slack to keep developing it.

Billing software lies further from the core operational competence and is only mentioned on the website. Still, the firm has no reported performance shortfall and has slack, so problemistic search is not triggered and the product is carried another year.
Equipment monitoring builds on the installed base and supports the expanding lifecycle service business. It needs few resources, so the firm keeps it.
Apron resource management complements turnaround management within the integrated suite, so dropping it would weaken the end-to-end offer. It is kept.
The controller safety alert service draws on the tower and surveillance expertise and serves safety goals central to customers. Absent evidence of a shortfall, slack allows the firm to keep it.
